title: What Does a Score Tell Us? Names, Units, and Comparisons

scenes.title: 점수는 무엇을 말해 줄까?
lines: How can a score display tell us what a game counts and what it evaluates?
We will first separate line counts from points in Tetris, then follow how a card contributes to a hand result and a running round score in Balatro.
Next, we will examine the reference used to compare opponents, then organize score labels and feedback so players can judge what to do next.

scenes.title: 무엇을 높게 평가할까?
lines: In Balatro, the hand type sets the starting calculation, and contributing cards and Jokers change chips and the multiplier. Selecting a card does not guarantee that it contributes to the score.

scenes.title: 이번 행동과 누적 결과
lines: Once a hand result is established, it is added to the round score. Separate this result, the running total, and the intermediate numbers shown while the addition animates.

scenes.title: 이름과 단위를 붙이기
lines: Balatro’s round score and target score serve different purposes. Likewise, the number of recovered items and an overall evaluation score can communicate different information.

scenes.title: 남아 있는 숫자와 지나가는 알림
lines: Separate the current hand calculation, the running round score, and the target to beat. Even while numbers react, the places to read them again stay stable.

scenes.title: 세 가지 질문으로 점검하기
lines: In Tetris, we distinguished line counts, evaluation points, and the gap between opponents. In Balatro, we examined card contributions, hand results versus round totals, and the order in which to read them.

scenes.title: 알림의 이름 읽기
lines: The three sevens contribute chips, but the six selected with them does not. Distinguish selection from contribution.

scenes.title: 사라지는 알림과 남는 기록
lines: Read the 560-point hand result separately from the running round total of 1,327. Intermediate animated values are not the final score.

scenes.title: 이름을 따라 숫자 읽기
lines: First read the hand type and its calculation, then check the round score after the result is added. Different labels give numbers different purposes.

scenes.title: 다시 찾을 위치
lines: Read the round score of 704 separately from the target of 1,200. The comparison remains available after the reacting calculation disappears.

scenes.title: 실제 화면에서 다시 점검하기
lines: Read the diamond card’s marker together with its reaction. Check whether a selected card contributes and which named value you are observing.
